meta.title: Daybreak Overture - Simo's Message
meta.description: I know that you're in my future, so I'm not afraid anymore.

units.rawText: Sako's excited to have you back, too. Right, the preparations are still underway. We should be ready to go later.
units.displayText: Sako's excited to have you back, too. Right, the preparations are still underway. We should be ready to go later.

spans.text: Sako's excited to have you back, too. Right, the preparations are still underway. We should be ready to go later.

units.rawText: I'll be looking forward to it, then. Oh, Simo, have your wounds from before healed?
units.displayText: I'll be looking forward to it, then. Oh, Simo, have your wounds from before healed?

spans.text: I'll be looking forward to it, then. Oh, Simo, have your wounds from before healed?

units.rawText: Yeah, thanks to the efforts of everyone at the medical department, I'm more or less back to before.
units.displayText: Yeah, thanks to the efforts of everyone at the medical department, I'm more or less back to before.

spans.text: Yeah, thanks to the efforts of everyone at the medical department, I'm more or less back to before.

units.rawText: The impact of Magrasea crumbling can still be felt... But everyone is hopeful again, and the restorations to the various sectors proceed apace.
units.displayText: The impact of Magrasea crumbling can still be felt... But everyone is hopeful again, and the restorations to the various sectors proceed apace.

spans.text: The impact of Magrasea crumbling can still be felt... But everyone is hopeful again, and the restorations to the various sectors proceed apace.

units.rawText: Professor, I fear you'll find no lack of work on your hands for the foreseeable future.
units.displayText: Professor, I fear you'll find no lack of work on your hands for the foreseeable future.

spans.text: Professor, I fear you'll find no lack of work on your hands for the foreseeable future.

units.rawText: But no matter what happens, you can order me as you like. I would be more than happy to help.
units.displayText: But no matter what happens, you can order me as you like. I would be more than happy to help.

spans.text: But no matter what happens, you can order me as you like. I would be more than happy to help.

units.rawText: I understand. Say, Simo. What plans do you have for the future?
units.displayText: I understand. Say, Simo. What plans do you have for the future?

spans.text: I understand. Say, Simo. What plans do you have for the future?

units.rawText: ...I've always dreamt of living in a peaceful world. All I have seen are destruction and death, war's din and shadow.
units.displayText: ...I've always dreamt of living in a peaceful world. All I have seen are destruction and death, war's din and shadow.

spans.text: ...I've always dreamt of living in a peaceful world. All I have seen are destruction and death, war's din and shadow.

units.rawText: But this time will be different. I wish to rebuild my home with my own two hands, and witness the new world with you.
units.displayText: But this time will be different. I wish to rebuild my home with my own two hands, and witness the new world with you.

spans.text: But this time will be different. I wish to rebuild my home with my own two hands, and witness the new world with you.

units.rawText: Professor, do you think I can manage that?
units.displayText: Professor, do you think I can manage that?

spans.text: Professor, do you think I can manage that?

units.rawText: That puts me at ease. Before my wishes are made reality, allow me to be by your side.
units.displayText: That puts me at ease. Before my wishes are made reality, allow me to be by your side.

spans.text: That puts me at ease. Before my wishes are made reality, allow me to be by your side.
